outcome: Relative number of blood vessels without a-smooth muscle actinin (a-SMA)
Vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) staining intensity
cohort: The study included thirty-eight paraffin-embedded specimens from premenopausal women who had undergone a hysterectomy, divided into those with adenomyosis and controls with unrelated pathologies.
finding: The study found increased angiogenesis and lymphangiogenesis, characterized by higher blood and lymph vessel densities, in the ectopic and eutopic endometrium of patients with adenomyosis compared to controls.
